page_annotations: The page is ruled, with a left margin column. Apart from the folio number, all writing is in two lines at about y 2735-3005.

The rest of the page was image-reviewed and contains no further text. There is faint show-through from the reverse side, ink blots at about (515,2450) and (1440,2500), faint specks at about (620,1820), and faint smudges at the bottom left at about (550-930, 4400-4490). None of these is legible text.
The strip of fol. 300 beyond the gutter (x > 3125) is facing-page context and was not transcribed.

Single holding line at y ≈2760-2810. The line runs from the tick in the margin column to 'at Benares.', followed by a separated right-hand field ending at about x 2905. The title, 'S.'/'3.', 'Scrib' and the scribe-name letters remain uncertain, and r002 already records this. No cancellations were seen.

Continuation line at y ≈2880-2990, with the interlinear 'ff.1-2' above the end of the underlined title. The caret sits below the baseline after the comma that follows the title. The connective before 'by one stray leaf' is ambiguous between '&' and '+'; r003 notes this. The attachment to b002 as a continuation is secure.
Short leftward arrow at about x 3010-3080, y ≈2790-2810, level with b002. It sits within the target page, before the gutter. Its function is unresolved.

Long leftward arrow at y ≈2930. Its arrowhead is at about x 2995 on the target page and the stroke continues across the gutter to the fol. 300 shelfmark '?. 96(2…'. Only the on-page portion belongs to this page. Its function is unresolved.
